compute.means: [means + [mean(xs)] for xs in [group('card.x')] for pm in [P * mean(xs)] for dmin in [min([abs(y - pm) for y in xs])] for nwin in [len([y for y in xs if abs(y - pm) == dmin])]][0]
compute.pays: [pays + [(20 / nwin if abs(answer('card.x') - pm) == dmin else 0)] for xs in [group('card.x')] for pm in [P * mean(xs)] for dmin in [min([abs(y - pm) for y in xs])] for nwin in [len([y for y in xs if abs(y - pm) == dmin])]][0]
compute.b_numbers: [join(', ', [('%g' % round(y, 2)) for y in sorted(xs)]) for xs in [group('card.x')] for pm in [P * mean(xs)] for dmin in [min([abs(y - pm) for y in xs])] for nwin in [len([y for y in xs if abs(y - pm) == dmin])]][0]
compute.b_mean: [('%g' % round(mean(xs), 2)) for xs in [group('card.x')] for pm in [P * mean(xs)] for dmin in [min([abs(y - pm) for y in xs])] for nwin in [len([y for y in xs if abs(y - pm) == dmin])]][0]
compute.b_pmean: [('%g' % round(pm, 2)) for xs in [group('card.x')] for pm in [P * mean(xs)] for dmin in [min([abs(y - pm) for y in xs])] for nwin in [len([y for y in xs if abs(y - pm) == dmin])]][0]
compute.b_winners: [join(', ', [('%g' % round(y, 2)) for y in sorted(xs) if abs(y - pm) == dmin]) for xs in [group('card.x')] for pm in [P * mean(xs)] for dmin in [min([abs(y - pm) for y in xs])] for nwin in [len([y for y in xs if abs(y - pm) == dmin])]][0]
compute.b_prize: [('%g' % round(20 / nwin, 2)) for xs in [group('card.x')] for pm in [P * mean(xs)] for dmin in [min([abs(y - pm) for y in xs])] for nwin in [len([y for y in xs if abs(y - pm) == dmin])]][0]

fields.prev: answer('card.x', r=r - 1) if r > 0 else None
fields.down: None if prev is None or x is None else (1 if x <= prev else 0)
fields.up: None if prev is None or x is None else (1 if x >= prev else 0)
fields.gt50: None if x is None else (1 if x > 50 else 0)
fields.eq50: None if x is None else (1 if x == 50 else 0)
fields.gt67: None if x is None else (1 if x > 67 else 0)
fields.in6667: None if x is None else (1 if x in (66, 67) else 0)
fields.in_1_99_100: None if x is None else (1 if x in (1, 99, 100) else 0)
fields.lt10: None if x is None else (1 if x < 10 else 0)
fields.lt1: None if x is None else (1 if x < 1 else 0)
fields.eq0: None if x is None else (1 if x == 0 else 0)
fields.eq100: None if x is None else (1 if x == 100 else 0)
fields.won13: None if r > 2 else (1 if pays[r] > 0 else 0)
fields.step: None if ref is None or x is None or P >= 1 else ('above' if x > ref else ('s0' if x > ref * P ** 0.5 else ('s1' if x > ref * P ** 1.5 else ('s2' if x > ref * P ** 2.5 else ('s3' if x > ref * P ** 3.5 else 'higher')))))

fields.Md: [(sorted(X[k])[len(X[k]) // 2] if len(X[k]) % 2 else (sorted(X[k])[len(X[k]) // 2 - 1] + sorted(X[k])[len(X[k]) // 2]) / 2) for k in range(4)]
fields.w_mean: (Mn[0] - Mn[3]) / Mn[0] if Mn[0] else None
fields.w_med: (Md[0] - Md[3]) / Md[0] if Md[0] else None
fields.Wn: [[1 if abs(X[k][j] - PMs[k]) == min([abs(y - PMs[k]) for y in X[k]]) else 0 for j in range(G)] for k in range(4)]
fields.A: [[(X[k][j] / REF[k] if REF[k] else None) for j in range(G)] for k in range(4)]
fields.AO: [(PMs[k] / REF[k] if REF[k] else None) for k in range(4)]
fields.OBS: [(t, j) for t in range(3) for j in range(G) if Wn[t][j] == 0 and A[t][j] is not None and A[t + 1][j] is not None and AO[t] is not None and A[t][j] != AO[t]]
fields.ldt_share: None if not OBS else mean([1 if ((A[t][j] > AO[t] and A[t + 1][j] < A[t][j]) or (A[t][j] < AO[t] and A[t + 1][j] > A[t][j])) else 0 for (t, j) in OBS])
fields.dec_share: None if not OBS else mean([1 if A[t + 1][j] < A[t][j] else 0 for (t, j) in OBS])
fields.ldt_major: None if ldt_share is None else (1 if ldt_share > 0.5 else 0)

answers.card.x: (min(100, (40 if arm == 'p43' else 50 * P ** 1.5) + 6 * my_index / group_size + (25 if arm == 'p43' else 0))) if r == 0 else (min(100, 100 if arm == 'p43' and r > 1 else answer('card.x', r=r - 1) * 4 / 3 + 5) if arm == 'p43' else answer('card.x', r=r - 1) / ([50] + means)[r - 1] * means[r - 1] * (0.8 if answer('card.x', r=r - 1) > P * means[r - 1] else 1.25))
